Welcome to Montana Horse Chiropractic Co. 🐎

I’m Dr. Jon Wilhelm, a certified veterinary chiropractor (IVCA, CVC) with a background in Olympic sports medicine and over two decades of clinical experience. I help horses move better and perform their best.

Through my videos, you’ll get a behind-the-scenes look at real equine chiropractic treatments, learn about assessing joint and soft tissue function, and pick up tips to support your horse’s movement, soundness, and comfort.

✅ Curious what full-body equine chiropractic care looks like?  Watch me work on real horses across Montana.

📚 Want to understand the techniques behind the work?
Stay tuned for stretching strategies, mobility tools, and performance-based care insights grounded in years of experience with elite athletes—both human and equine.

🔔 Subscribe for: 
• Equine chiropractic demos
• Mobility and stretching techniques
• Ranch call footage
• Sport horse performance care
• Expert tips from the field

📍 Based in Manhattan, MT
